records.title: Missing Content Security Policy
records.summary: A missing Content Security Policy is a secure configuration concern that can increase browser-side risk when script-capable applications are present.
records.remediation_summary: Define a restrictive Content Security Policy appropriate for the application and test it in report-only mode before enforcement.
safe_next_steps: Review supplied headers and application script requirements before proposing a CSP policy.

records.title: Wildcard CORS With Credentials
records.summary: A permissive CORS configuration that allows credentials should be reviewed because it may allow unintended browser access patterns.
records.remediation_summary: Restrict allowed origins and avoid combining broad origins with credentialed browser requests.
safe_next_steps: Confirm intended CORS trust boundaries with the application owner.

records.title: API Surface Without Clear Auth Indicators
records.summary: Imported API-like paths without authentication indicators should be reviewed as an inventory and authorization design question.
references: OWASP API Security Top 10 API1/API2 review area
records.remediation_summary: Confirm whether imported API endpoints require authentication or explicit public access.
safe_next_steps: Review API inventory and documented authentication requirements before any live validation.
